config_file_text:
paths:
  output_dir: "/data2/jt577/2026/08.2026/blob_EAT/08.28/out_NIST_edge_110_dislocation_GEAT_GA_08.27.26_discrete_FIRE_tournament"
  nist_dump_dir: "/data2/jt577/2026/07.2026/blob_EAT/07.17/NIST_dump_files"
  import_structures_json: ""

model:
  mp_api_key: ""
  model_name: "uma-s-1p1"
  task_name: "omat"

crystal:
  defect: "edge_110"
  subcell_size_angstrom: 40.0
  relaxable_region_size_angstrom: 25.0
  vacuum_padding_angstrom: 8.0

initialization:
  # "eat" selects legacy fractional EAT initialization; "discrete" selects
  # Poisson-count hard atoms. It applies to generation 0 and random immigrants.
  random_member_initialization: "discrete"
  discrete_count_min: 1
  discrete_count_max_factor: 2.0
  discrete_repair_attempts: 2000
  null_density_per_angstrom3: 0.15
  subcell_grid: "6, 6, 6"
  init_occ_total: 0.2
  init_occ_noise: 0.0
  init_species_dirichlet_alpha: 5.0
  init_position_mode: "subcell_grid"
  init_position_jitter_angstrom: 0.15
  keep_thresh: 0.001
  seed: null

objective:
  composition_penalty: 0.0
  hole_boundary_penalty: 0.0
  hole_boundary_margin_angstrom: 0.0
  occupancy_lower_bound_enable: true
  occupancy_lower_bound_gamma: 0.3
  occupancy_lower_bound_penalty: 20.0
  occupancy_lower_bound_softplus_sharpness: 0.5
  reference_relax_enable: true
  reference_relax_fmax: 0.05
  reference_relax_steps: 500
  reference_relax_maxstep_angstrom: 0.08

candidate_relaxation:
  enable: true
  fmax: 0.05
  steps: 500
  maxstep_angstrom: 0.08
  unconverged_penalty: 0.0

syntropization:
  tsallis_q: 2.0
  beta0: 0.001
  beta_mult: 1.5
  beta_max_stages: 0
  entropy_stop_avg: 0.0001
  binary_stop_maxmin: 0.001
  also_require_binary_stop: false

minimizer:
  maxit: 100
  tol: 0.005
  bfgs_hist: 10
  max_line_search: 3

history:
  disable_trajectory_history: true
  history_every: 1

genetic:
  enable: true
  population_size: 30
  generations: 100
  elite_fraction: 0.10
  crossover_fraction: 0.65
  random_fraction: 0.25
  parent_pool_size: 30
  import_parent_count: 0
  parent_a_tournament_size: 2
  superposition_occ_scale: 0.5
  superposition_prune_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  superposition_prune_occ_thresh: 0.001
  crossover_pos_sigma: 0.30
  crossover_occ_sigma: 0.05
  crossover_species_sigma: 0.0
  live_plot_enable: true
  live_plot_file: ""
  live_plot_metric: "score"
  live_plot_alpha: 0.45
  live_plot_jitter: 0.16
  parallel_workers: 2
  parallel_gpu_ids: "0,1"
  execution_backend: "local"
  log_file: ""

runtime:
  terminal_verbose: false
  heartbeat_interval_seconds: 60.0
  running_log_file: ""
